items.question: This sewing workshop is ideal for beginner tailors ------- professionals who would like to refresh their knowledge.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“as well as”代入题干后为“This sewing workshop is ideal for beginner tailors as well as professionals who would like to refresh their knowledge.”。选择理由：该项符合空格处所需的介词或固定搭配，并使句意完整。正确答案：C（as well as）。
